en.title: Canada Premiers Sign Accessibility MOU as Subway Upgrades and Grants Boost Disability Access
en.summary: Canada's premiers signed an MOU with Rick Hansen's Wheels in Motion to improve nationwide accessibility. Meanwhile, a historic Brooklyn subway station completed its accessibility upgrade with three new elevators, and ArtsWestchester received a $5M state grant for expansion and accessibility improvements. Also, Zoom announced AI enhancements to boost accessibility, while an interview highlighted digital advocacy and a report warned of growing AI-related accessibility debt.

highlights.title: Century-Old Brooklyn Subway Station Completes Full Accessibility Upgrade with Three New Elevators
ArtsWestchester receives $5M state investment for expansion and accessibility improvements
Zoom Prioritizes AI Quality to Enhance Accessibility and Collaboration

Deque Report on AI and Accessibility Debt

zh-TW.title: 加拿大省長簽署無障礙備忘錄 市鐵站升級 藝術中心獲資助
zh-TW.summary: 加拿大省長與Rick Hansen的Wheels in Motion簽署無障礙備忘錄，旨在提升全國無障礙環境。布碌崙百年地鐵站完成無障礙升級，新增三部電梯；ArtsWestchester獲得500萬美元州補助用於擴建與無障礙改善。Zoom宣布將提升AI品質以強化無障礙功能，同時一篇訪談探討數位無障礙倡導，報告警示AI將增加無障礙債務。
